2609.27517.title: Not What You Meant: Can LLMs Follow a Specified Negation Semantics?
2609.27517.paper_summary: Negation does not carry a uniform interpretation across domains. In legal, regulatory, and medical reasoning, the intended interpretation depends on the reading in force -- open- versus closed-world, two- versus three-valued, and credulous versus skeptical. We study which reading of negation large language models adopt by default and whether they can override that preference when a different reading is explicitly specified. To this end, we introduce NAFBench, a procedural generator of solver-certified instances spanning four semantic viewpoints: SLDNF, well-founded semantics (WFS), and credulous and skeptical reasoning under stable-model semantics. The generator emits ground normal logic programs with controlled depth, width, and cycle structure. Each program is solved under all four viewpoints using SWI-Prolog, a well-founded semantics solver, and clingo, yielding up to four divergent labels. The programs are then verbalized into natural language under multiple framings and rule orderings that leave the answer invariant. The results expose a consistent gap. Across open-source models, following a specified negation semantics remains unsolved: the strongest models score 59--74% across the four semantic viewpoints, while the weakest score 31--67%. All models are order-sensitive on more than half of logically identical rule shufflings, while the two weaker models frequently overcommit on well-founded "undefined." Two frontier models reach 100% on the main fixed-complexity evaluation set, and a third, o4-mini, is near-perfect, falling only to 81% on well-founded "undefined." Delegating reasoning to a solver, fine-tuning on certified traces, or forcing an explicit three-valued verdict each partly closes the gap.
2609.27517.paper_summary_zh: 否定在不同領域中並不具有統一的解釋。在法律、監管和醫療推理中，預期的解釋取決於所採用的閱讀方式——開放世界與封閉世界、二值與三值、以及輕信與懷疑。我們研究大型語言模型預設採用的否定閱讀方式，以及在明確指定不同閱讀時它們是否能覆蓋該偏好。為此，我們引入NAFBench，一個程序生成器，生成涵蓋四種語義觀點的解算器認證實例：SLDNF、良基語義（WFS）、以及在穩定模型語義下的輕信和懷疑推理。該生成器生成具有可控深度、寬度和循環結構的基底正常邏輯程序。每個程序在所有四種觀點下使用SWI-Prolog（一個良基語義解算器）和clingo進行求解，產生最多四個不同的標籤。然後，這些程序在多種框架和規則排序下被轉化為自然語言，這些框架和排序保持答案不變。結果揭示了一個一致的差距。在開源模型中，遵循指定的否定語義仍然未解決：最強的模型在四種語義觀點中的得分為59%至74%，而最弱的模型得分為31%至67%。所有模型在超過一半的邏輯相同規則洗牌中對順序敏感，而兩個較弱的模型經常在良基的「未定義」上過度承諾。兩個前沿模型在主要固定複雜度評估集上達到100%，而第三個模型o4-mini接近完美，在良基的「未定義」上僅降至81%。將推理委託給解算器、在認證痕跡上進行微調，或強制明確的三值判決各自部分縮小了這一差距。
